title: Grateful Dead Live at Civic Center on 1973-03-28
lineage: Cassette Master -> Apogee MiniMe -> Samplitude Professional 8.01 -> FLAC/16

ai_review.summary: A blistering ’73 show captured in a clear audience recording that puts you right in the middle of Garcia’s top‑shelf playing and high‑energy jams.
ai_review.review: The performance is repeatedly described as “on fire,” with standout renditions of Cumberland Blues, Here Comes Sunshine, China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider and a memorable second‑set flow that even the mono recording can’t dampen. The audience (AUD) source is praised for its immersive presence despite slight muffling and a mono second set, making this an excellent listening experience overall.

ai_rating.rationale: Reviews overwhelmingly rate the show 4‑5 stars for musical quality with many calling it a highlight of ’73, while the recording is consistently rated good to very good despite minor muffling; weighted average yields ~4.6.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Generally clear and immersive with a slightly muffled feel; second set is mono, Bill’s bass could be louder in the mix but overall very listenable.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: Strong, high‑energy first set that builds into a legendary second set; even the mono portion maintains momentum and excitement.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised as the best ’73 Garcia ever heard – perfect tone, “plays his ass off,” rolls out the carpet on TLEO.
band_member_comments.Phil: Box of Rain highlighted; note that Phil’s vocal on it isn’t as strong as in earlier years.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bill’s bass is present but could be a bit louder in the mix.
